items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Did you, did you know Henry Ponce?

ctx.x: Uh, no. Uh, only Tranchini that had a place where we played at with, uh, with, uh, Mumford ourselves. Uh, um, uh, Uh, let's see. Uh, he's king to the Mumford's too. He's a piano player. And, uh, the Tranchini had, he had a, he had a, all of them there at the corner of Claiborne and, and Tulane Avenue. Uh-huh. That was a nice spot there, but that was only for the weekend. Uh, Leon Mumford. Leon Mumford played trombone, uh, piano. Uh-huh. And I played, uh, I was playing banjo. And T-Boy Remy was playing trumpet.…

Did you, did you know Henry Ponce? Ponce. Henry Ponce. He had a joint near Segretas. They had a little fight going.
